units.zh: 2026年亚太经合组织领导人深圳展望 建设亚太共同体，促进共同繁荣
units.en: 2026 APEC Leaders’ Shenzhen Outlook Building an Asia-Pacific Community to Prosper Together

units.zh: 我们，亚太经合组织领导人，于2026年11月18日至19日在中国深圳举行会议。亚太经合组织成立数十年来，在我们持续努力下，本地区已成为全球增长的重要引擎和区域经济合作的典范。今年以来，我们围绕“建设亚太共同体，促进共同繁荣”主题，聚焦中国设定的2026年亚太经合组织三大优先领域“开放、创新、合作”，以《2040年亚太经合组织布特拉加亚愿景》为指引，持续推进工作，朝着建成开放、活力、强韧、和平的亚太共同体这一共同目标不断迈进。
units.en: We, the Economic Leaders of APEC, gathered in Shenzhen, China, on November 18 to 19, 2026. Decades after APEC’s establishment, our sustained efforts have helped make our region a key engine of global growth and a champion of regional economic cooperation. Under the theme “Building an Asia-Pacific Community to Prosper Together”, we have built on our work throughout the year with China’s APEC 2026 priorities “Openness, Innovation, Cooperation”, and advanced our shared objectives toward realizing an open, dynamic, resilient, and peaceful Asia-Pacific community, guided by the Putrajaya Vision 2040.

units.zh: 当今世界快速变革，新兴机遇与复杂挑战并存。技术突破为促进本地区经济增长、韧性和活力作出贡献。我们致力于携手努力，维护宏观经济稳定，提升生产力和活力，促进经济增长，造福全体人民。
units.en: The world today is changing rapidly, with new opportunities emerging alongside complex challenges. Technological breakthroughs are contributing to the economic growth, resilience, and dynamism of our region. We endeavor to work together to maintain macroeconomic stability, promote productivity and dynamism, and boost economic growth for the benefit of all our people.

units.zh: 亚太经合组织长期以来处在区域经济合作前沿，在当前经济背景下依然发挥着重要作用。我们重申，亚太经合组织是区域经济合作的首要平台，我们将遵循自主自愿、非约束性和协商一致的合作原则，致力于将亚太经合组织打造成一个更加现代、高效、务实的理念孵化器。
units.en: APEC has long been at the forefront of regional economic cooperation, and its enduring role remains relevant in the current economic context. We reaffirm our commitment to APEC as the premier forum for regional economic cooperation, guided by its voluntary, non-binding and consensus-building principles, and to making APEC a more modern, efficient, and effective incubator of ideas.

units.zh: 经贸和投资
units.en: Trade and Investment

units.zh: 我们强调，支持改善贸易和投资环境的努力对本地区具有重要意义。我们重申致力于加强供应链韧性、深化区域经济合作，建设稳健且有韧性的经济，为本地区实现持续的经济增长与繁荣作出贡献。
units.en: We underscore that supporting efforts to improve the trade and investment environment is important to our region. We reaffirm our commitments to strengthening supply chain resilience and deepening regional economic cooperation to build robust and resilient economies, contributing to sustained economic growth and prosperity of our region.

units.zh: 我们将继续以市场驱动的方式，包括通过落实亚太自由贸易区相关议程，推进亚太区域经济一体化。我们认识到，亚太自由贸易区议程在提升各经济体参与高标准、综合性区域自贸安排的能力方面发挥着重要作用。
units.en: We will continue advancing economic integration in the Asia-Pacific region in a manner that is market-driven, including through the work on the Free Trade Area of the Asia-Pacific (FTAAP) agenda. We recognize that the FTAAP agenda plays an important role in building economies’ capacity to participate in high standard and comprehensive regional undertakings.

units.zh: 我们认识到数字化对驱动本地区创新、促进生产力和经济增长的重要作用，及其对促进贸易的积极作用。在此背景下，我们欢迎《亚太经合组织贸易数字化合作框架（2027－2030）》，以此指导各方努力营造有利的政策环境、加强政策交流，并推动将数字技术应用在贸易数字化进程之中。我们将继续促进贸易便利化，包括通过实施无纸化贸易和跨境电子商务等措施。我们也致力于发挥新兴技术对贸易的促进作用。
units.en: We recognize the important role of digitalization as a driver for innovation, productivity, and economic growth across the region, and its benefit to facilitating trade. In this context, we welcome the APEC Trade Digitalization Cooperation Framework (2027-2030) to guide our efforts to foster a supportive policy environment, strengthen policy exchange and promote use of digital technologies for trade digitalization. We will continue to facilitate trade, including through measures to advance paperless trade and cross-border e-commerce. We are also committed to harnessing the benefits of emerging technologies for trade.

units.zh: 我们认识到服务业对促进经济增长和创造就业的贡献，以及数字服务日益扩大的作用，将继续提升亚太经合组织各经济体在服务业领域的竞争力。我们注意到环境及相关挑战带来的影响，鼓励亚太经合组织各经济体思考如何通过能力建设和经验交流，助力实现各自的环境与贸易目标。我们也认可亚太经合组织过去和当前在推动有韧性的商业模式合作方面所做的工作。我们肯定文化创意产业对经济增长的积极贡献，并重申强有力的知识产权保护的重要性。我们致力于加强知识产权保护和执法，并持续努力解决创新者、创作者及其他知识产权持有者所面临的挑战。
units.en: Recognizing the contribution of the services sector to economic growth and job creation, and the expanding role of digitally-delivered services, we will continue to enhance the competitiveness of the APEC economies in the sector. We note the impacts of environmental and related challenges and encourage APEC economies to consider how capacity building and exchanges of experience can help meet their respective environmental and trade objectives. We also recognize APEC’s past and ongoing work to foster cooperation in advancing resilient business models. We acknowledge the positive contribution of the cultural and creative industries (CCIs) to economic growth, and affirm the importance of robust intellectual property protections. We are committed to enhancing the protection and enforcement of intellectual property rights, as well as continued efforts to address challenges faced by innovators, creators, and other right holders.

units.zh: 联通
units.en: Connectivity

units.zh: 我们重申，互联互通一直是经济增长的渠道，促进了商品、服务、资本和人员的流动，交通网络的安全与韧性为其提供了支持。我们赞赏亚太经合组织过去十年为推进区域互联互通所作的努力。在现有进展基础上，我们核可《亚太经合组织互联互通蓝图》，鼓励各经济体继续努力，通过进一步夯实“硬联通”、“软联通”、“心联通”三大支柱，实现无缝、全面联通和融合亚太。我们将继续加强互联互通，为所有人带来实实在在的利益。我们将加强合作，促进高质量基础设施开发和投资。我们也强调投资的重要性，包括通过事前投资来减少灾害风险。
units.en: We affirm that connectivity has served as a conduit for economic growth, facilitating the flow of goods, services, capital, and people, including as supported by safe and resilient transport links. We appreciate the efforts made by APEC to advance regional connectivity over the past decade. Building on this progress, we endorse the APEC Connectivity Blueprint, through which we encourage economies to continue efforts towards achieving a seamlessly and comprehensively connected and integrated Asia-Pacific, by further strengthening the three pillars: physical, institutional, and people-to-people. We will continue to advance connectivity to deliver tangible benefits for all. We will enhance cooperation on quality infrastructure development and investment. We also underscore the importance of investment, including through ex-ante investment in disaster risk reduction.

units.zh: 面对影响我们地区的供应链挑战，我们重申致力于维护供应链韧性，特别是必需品的供应链。我们认识到，保持本区域互联互通、贸易走廊开放，以促进包括能源供应和其他必需品的贸易流动，符合我们的共同利益。我们决心与其他贸易伙伴共同努力，确保贸易持续流动，确保关键基础设施继续支撑全球供应链的运转和完整。我们支持增强供应链韧性、解决瓶颈问题、利用亚太经合组织现有平台促进供应链互联互通和贸易便利化。我们欢迎对《供应链互联互通框架行动计划（第三期）》（2022－2026）的终期审议。我们也认识到，政策透明至关重要，否则可能影响贸易或扰乱供应链。
units.en: In the face of supply chain challenges impacting our region, we reaffirm our commitment to maintaining resilient supply chains, particularly for essential goods. We recognize that it is in our mutual interest that our region remains interconnected and trade corridors remain open to facilitate trade flows, including energy supplies and other essential goods. We affirm our resolve to work together and with other trade partners to ensure trade continues to flow and critical infrastructure continues to support the viability and integrity of supply chains globally. We support efforts to enhance supply chain resilience, address chokepoints, and leverage existing platforms in APEC to advance supply chain connectivity and trade facilitation. We welcome the final review of Phase Three of the Supply Chain Connectivity Framework Action Plan (SCFAP III) (2022-2026). We also recognize the importance of transparency of measures that may affect trade or disrupt supply chains.

units.zh: 我们将继续加强交通领域的合作以推动创新，增强信息通信技术韧性。我们将继续推广良好监管实践，在标准和评定程序方面努力加强合作，并推进结构性改革以改善营商环境。我们也将就贸易数字化、供应链、贸易便利化开展务实经验交流，提升海关数字化水平，完善其他与贸易相关的流程。我们鼓励通过亚太经合组织商务旅行卡促进商务人员流动，欢迎各经济体推动旅游便利化、加强教育和技能培训、促进文化交流。
units.en: We will continue cooperation to advance innovation and foster ICT resilience in the transport sector. We will continue to promote good regulatory practices, strengthen cooperation on standards and conformity assessment procedures, pursue structural reform to improve the business environment. We will also foster practical exchange of experience on trade digitalization, supply chains, trade facilitation, advance digitalization of customs and trade-related procedures. We encourage business mobility through the APEC Business Travel Card, and welcome economies’ efforts to advance tourism facilitation, strengthen education, skills development and cultural exchanges.

units.zh: 创新
units.en: Innovation

units.zh: 我们认识到，技术和创新正在深刻重塑亚太经济体，并驱动地区经济迅速增长。我们将推进技术进步，推动创新驱动增长，着力提高生产力，改善生活质量，拓展繁荣机遇，造福所有人民。为此，我们支持科技与创新合作，培育具有竞争力、韧性且安全的创新生态系统。我们鼓励就良好实践进行自愿交流，为本土创新生态系统发展提供支持。
units.en: We recognize that technology and innovation are profoundly reshaping our economies and rapidly driving economic growth in the Asia-Pacific region. We will leverage technological advancement to pursue innovation-driven and productivity-led growth, improve quality of life, and promote prosperity and opportunity for all our peoples. To this end, we support science, technology, and innovation cooperation to foster a competitive, resilient and secure innovation ecosystem. We encourage the voluntary exchange of good practices to support the growth of local innovation ecosystems.

units.zh: 我们重申致力于发展数字经济，让所有人民共享数字转型红利。我们鼓励各经济体推进数字互联互通，弥合社会各阶层以及城乡区域间的数字鸿沟，加强可及、有韧性的数字基础设施建设，推动数字转型，促进经济增长，提升数字素养与技能，推进数字平台建设。我们鼓励各经济体积极应对相关潜在风险，包括数据泄露、网络诈骗以及蓄意滥用人工智能和其他新兴技术从事恶意活动等，以加强和改善数字环境。我们认识到尊重知识产权对数字和新兴技术发展的重要性。我们认识到数据在推动数字转型中的关键作用。我们将继续加强在跨境数据流动、数字交易安全性以及数据保护和隐私等方面的合作。
units.en: We reaffirm our commitment to growing the digital economy and sharing the benefits of digital transformation with all our peoples. We encourage economies to advance digital connectivity and bridge digital divides across all segments of society and across regions between urban and rural areas, strengthen accessible and resilient digital infrastructure, promote digital transformation for economic growth, enhance digital literacy and skills, and promote the development of digital platforms. We encourage economies to address potential risks such as data breaches, online scams and deliberate misuse of digital and emerging technologies for malicious purposes, to strengthen and enhance the digital environment. We recognize the importance of respecting intellectual property rights in the development of digital and emerging technologies. We recognize the vital role of data in powering digital transformation. We will continue our cooperation on facilitating the flow of data across borders, strengthening business and consumer trust in digital transactions, and ensuring data protection and privacy.

units.zh: 我们强调，数字和新兴技术为整个亚太地区带来了变革性机遇，有助于提升生产力、效率、竞争力和韧性，促进经济增长。我们赞赏亚太经合组织为推进数字和新兴技术相关讨论所作的努力，包括《亚太经合组织人工智能倡议（2026－2030）》，并通过《亚太经合组织关于亚太地区新兴技术促进就业和繁荣的声明》，以继续推进这一重要工作。我们支持以人民为中心的创新，支持采取负责任的方式，促进数字和新兴技术在各经济领域应用，造福全体人民。我们支持推动关键领域的数字和新兴技术转型，利用数字和新兴技术改善公共服务，包括加强医疗卫生体系建设，为企业营造有利的发展环境，推广以市场为导向、以创新为驱动的做法，并为中小微企业提供可及的数字工具以赋能其发展。我们将继续投资数字和新兴技术相关基础设施，推进数据利用，激发创新活力。
units.en: We underscore that digital and emerging technologies present transformative opportunities to boost productivity, efficiency, competitiveness, resilience, and economic growth across the Asia-Pacific. We commend APEC’s efforts to advance discussions on digital and emerging technologies including the APEC AI Initiative (2026-2030), and endorse APEC Statement on Harnessing Digital and Emerging Technologies for Employment and Prosperity in the Asia-Pacific Region to continue this important work. We will support human-centric innovation, responsible approaches, and the adoption of digital and emerging technologies across all sectors of the economy for the benefit of all our peoples. We support driving digital and emerging technologies transformation across key sectors, harnessing digital and emerging technologies to improve public service delivery, including strengthening healthcare systems, fostering an enabling environment for businesses, promoting market-oriented and innovation-driven approaches, and empowering micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) with accessible digital tools. We will continue to invest in infrastructure related to digital and emerging technologies and advance data utilization to fuel innovation.

units.zh: 经济增长
units.en: Economic Growth

units.zh: 我们认识到全民经济赋权是促进生产力和创新、强化经济参与度的重要途径。我们强调，应该帮助劳动者为未来工作做好准备，以把握技术进步带来的益处，并根据《亚太经合组织应对人口结构变化框架合作文件》应对人口结构变化。我们重申致力于提升人力资源开发现代化水平，促进高质量、充分、生产性和体面的就业，促进终身学习、职业培训、技能提升和再培训，保护劳动者权利，在不断变化的工作环境中继续努力提升相关国际劳工标准，以及酌情优化社会保障体系。
units.en: We recognize that the economic empowerment of all is an important way to boost productivity and innovation and strengthen participation in the economy. We emphasize the importance of preparing our workforce for the future of work to capture the benefits of technological advancement and respond to demographic changes in line with the APEC Collaborative Framework for Demographic Changes. We reaffirm our commitment to modernizing human resources development through promoting high-quality, full, productive and decent employment, lifelong learning, vocational training, reskilling and upskilling, protecting the rights of workers and continuing efforts to promote international labour standards in the changing world of work, and optimizing social security systems as appropriate.

units.zh: 我们强调可信且灵活的财政、货币和金融政策框架对于应对冲击、维护宏观经济和金融稳定的重要性。我们也注意到，全球失衡问题持续存在，给增长与稳定带来了风险。我们认识到，全球再平衡符合我们的共同利益，并同意就此加强沟通与合作。我们鼓励应用财政政策支持家庭，促进全民金融可及性、拓展金融机会、提升金融素养，认识到金融知识对财务健康和人民福祉至关重要。
units.en: We emphasize the importance of credible and flexible fiscal, monetary and financial policy frameworks to manage shocks, maintain macroeconomic and financial stability. We note that global imbalances have persisted, creating risks to growth and stability. We recognize that global rebalancing is in our common interest and agree to strengthen communication and cooperation in this regard. We encourage fiscal policies to support households and promote financial access, opportunity and literacy for all, recognizing that financial literacy is important to financial health and well-being.

units.zh: 我们寻求加强跨能源部门和跨技术的综合安全，共同应对能源安全挑战，确保不间断、可依赖、可负担和可持续地获取能源，以支撑经济繁荣。我们鼓励围绕供应链韧性、基础设施互联互通、风险评估加强能源安全协作。我们认识到及时修复发电厂、电网、海底电力电缆和管道等关键能源基础设施的重要性，并鼓励各经济体围绕市场机制、应急准备和响应、战略储备管理进行经验交流。我们认识到，安全且不间断的能源流动至关重要，应在互利的基础上开展涵盖整个供应链的合作，包括生产者与消费者之间的合作，同时促进区域内能源合作。我们将推广安全、可靠、充足、有韧性和可负担的高质量能源，在包括偏远地区和农村在内的所有地区普遍可及。我们鼓励深化自愿合作，推动数字和新兴技术与能源之间相互促进，支持为数字和新兴技术发展提供可靠、有韧性且可负担的能源，同时利用数字和新兴技术完善能源系统，惠及全民。我们认识到，传统能源以及零排放、低排放能源和技术为能源安全以及强劲和可持续的经济增长提供了基础，各经济体将根据自身优先事项选择能源系统组合。
units.en: We seek to strengthen comprehensive security across all energy sectors and technologies and jointly address energy security challenges, ensuring uninterrupted, reliable, and affordable access to energy to enable economic prosperity. We encourage strengthened energy security through cooperation on supply chain resilience, secure cross-border infrastructure interconnection, and risk assessment. We recognize the benefits of timely restoration of critical energy infrastructure such as power plants, electric grids, submarine power cables and pipelines, and encourage sharing of economies’ experiences on market mechanisms, emergency preparedness and response, and strategic reserve management. We recognize the importance of secure and uninterrupted energy flows and cooperation across the whole supply chain including between producers and consumers in a mutually beneficial manner as well as fostering energy cooperation in the region. We will promote universal access to high-quality energy that is secure, reliable, abundant, resilient, and affordable, including for remote and rural areas. We encourage deepening voluntary cooperation on mutual enhancement between digital and emerging technologies and energy by supporting reliable, resilient and affordable energy for digital and emerging technologies development while harnessing digital and emerging technologies to enhance energy systems that deliver benefits for all. We recognize that conventional and zero and low emission energy sources and technologies provide a foundation for energy security, and strong and sustainable economic growth, and that each economy will choose an energy system mix consistent with its domestic priorities.

units.zh: 我们将努力促进开放、公平、透明、高产出、有韧性和创新的农业粮食体系，以惠及全民。我们将加强粮食安全政策伙伴关系，提高农业生产力和效率，通过创新和数字化增强区域粮食体系韧性，促进农业粮食体系转型，促进食品安全，改善全民营养，防止和减少粮食损失与浪费。我们支持基于科学和证据、由技术赋能的农业，包括用好数字和新兴技术等工具，并推进农业生物技术发展。我们重申致力于为农村地区拓展经济机遇。
units.en: We will work towards promoting open, fair, transparent, productive, resilient, and innovative agri-food systems that benefit all. We will strengthen policy partnership on food security, boost agricultural productivity and efficiency, enhance the resilience of regional food systems and supply chains, including through innovation and digitalization, promote the transformation of agri-food systems, advance food safety and nutrition for all, and prevent and reduce food loss and waste. We support science- and evidence-based, technology-enabled agriculture, including utilizing tools such as digital and emerging technologies and the advancement in agricultural biotechnology. We reaffirm our commitment to strengthening economic opportunities in rural areas.

units.zh: 我们认识到，森林为经济增长、生物多样性保护以及亚太地区的社区韧性和繁荣提供多重价值和贡献。我们支持合作打击非法采伐及相关贸易，促进合法采伐的林产品、可持续森林管理，制止并扭转森林丧失与退化。我们还将协作提升海洋和沿海社区的韧性，促进海洋资源的保护和管理，包括通过基于科学和技术的方式，打击非法、不报告和不受管制的捕捞，应对日益严峻的海洋垃圾挑战。
units.en: We recognize the multiple values and contributions that forests provide for economic growth, biodiversity conservation, and the resilience and prosperity of communities across the Asia-Pacific region. We support cooperation on combating illegal logging and associated trade while promoting legally harvested forest products, sustainable forest management, and halting and reversing forest loss and degradation. We will also collaborate to improve the resilience of marine and coastal communities and promote the conservation and management of ocean resources, including by combating illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing and addressing the growing challenge of marine debris, while leveraging science- and technology-based approaches.

units.zh: 我们致力于打造有利的营商环境，支持中小微企业和初创企业抓住机遇，增强竞争力和创新性，实现增长。我们将支持中小微企业更好地获得资本、资产、技能培训和数字工具，支持中小微企业参与区域和全球价值链，并鼓励各经济体继续为中小微企业能力建设提供支持。我们鼓励开发可及、易用且具有成本效益的产品和解决方案，帮助中小微企业提高生产力和效率、扩大市场参与、加速数字化转型，并推动经济主体从非正规经济向正规经济和全球经济转型。
units.en: We are committed to fostering an enabling business environment that supports the growth of MSMEs and startups through opportunities to become more competitive and innovative. We will promote greater access for MSMEs to capital, assets, skills training and digital tools, support MSMEs’ participation in value chains, and encourage economies to continue providing support for MSMEs capacity building. We encourage the development of accessible, easy-to-use and cost-effective products and solutions that help MSMEs boost productivity and efficiency, expand market participation, accelerate digital transformation and facilitate the transition of economic actors from the informal to the formal and global economies.

units.zh: 我们认识到腐败的破坏性影响，它威胁经济增长、侵蚀公众信任、损害贸易和公平竞争，使资源偏离关键领域，为有组织犯罪等非法行为创造条件。我们决心通过有效的反腐倡廉措施促进增长与繁荣，继续共同努力反腐，包括打击跨境腐败，不为腐败分子和通过腐败及非法资产牟利者提供避风港，并就资产追回和返还加强合作。
units.en: We recognize the detrimental impact of corruption as a threat to economic growth, eroding public trust, harming trade and fair competition, diverting resources away from vital areas, and facilitating crimes, including organized crime. We resolve to promote growth and prosperity through effective anti-corruption and integrity measures, and continue our joint efforts to fight against corruption, including cross-border corruption, deny safe haven to corruption offenders including people who benefit from corruption and illicit assets, and strengthen cooperation on asset recovery and return.

units.zh: 作为我们共同努力深化亚太地区各领域合作的一部分，我们注意到2026年举行了妇女与经济、贸易、旅游、数字与人工智能、林业、粮食安全、中小企业、能源、运输、人力资源开发、财政等专业部长会议，以及数字周系列活动等其他高级别活动。我们赞赏亚太经合组织第37届外交和贸易双部长会议的成果，包括批准《奥特奥罗亚行动计划》五年审议，这些成果将作为未来合作的重要基础。
units.en: As part of our collective endeavors to deepen regional cooperation across all fronts, we note the convening of the 2026 sectoral ministerial meetings for Women and the Economy, Trade, Tourism, Digital and AI, Forestry, Food Security, Small and Medium Enterprises, Energy, Transportation, Human Resources Development, Finance, as well as other high-level events including during the Digital Weeks. We commend the outcomes of the 37th APEC Ministerial Meeting as an important basis for future cooperation, including the adoption of the five-year review of the Aotearoa Plan of Action.

units.zh: 工商界和其他利益相关方给亚太经合组织带来创造力、活力和能量，始终是我们的重要伙伴。我们期待与包括亚太经合组织工商咨询理事会和太平洋经济合作理事会在内的广大利益相关方进一步加强交流合作。
units.en: Our business communities and other stakeholders bring creativity, dynamism, and energy to APEC and remain vital partners in our work. We look forward to further strengthening multi-stakeholder engagement, as appropriate, including with the APEC Business Advisory Council (ABAC) and Pacific Economic Cooperation Council (PECC).

units.zh: 我们衷心感谢今年东道主中华人民共和国，感谢广东省深圳市的周到安排以及市民的热情好客。我们欢迎越南（2027年）、墨西哥（2028年）、新加坡（2030年）、日本（2031年）、智利（2032年）、巴布亚新几内亚（2033年）以及秘鲁（2034年）担任未来几年亚太经合组织东道主。
units.en: We extend our sincere gratitude to the People’s Republic of China and the people and city of Shenzhen, Guangdong Province for their warm hospitality and thorough arrangements. We look forward to the upcoming APEC host years of Viet Nam (2027), Mexico (2028), Singapore (2030), Japan (2031), Chile (2032), Papua New Guinea (2033), and Peru (2034).
